column1: # Scenarios of this repository's own pipeline (workflow ci), run by run-scenarios.sh.
# Fields, separated by tabs: name, expectation, change, commit message (optional).
# What each job reads (from its trace on main): no job reads docs/. go-test, go-lint,
# build and security-scan read and list internal/report; e2e-plan attaches the
# workspace of build; policy-test, script-test and orb-validate do not touch it.

column3: printf '\nThe planner never skips a job it cannot prove is unaffected.\n' >> docs/limitations.md
sed -i 's|^// maxChangedInMarkdown is how many changed files plan\.md lists\.$|// maxChangedInMarkdown is how many changed files plan.md lists at most.|' internal/report/report.go

printf '# report

Writes plan.json and plan.md.
' > internal/report/NOTES.md
column4: docs(report): add a note on the package
